item.title: Nook 1.2.0
item.description:
Nook 1.2 — Nook now updates itself.

  • Automatic updates: Nook checks once a day and offers new versions (Settings → Updates, or menu bar → Check for Updates…)
  • Updates are signed by Nook and notarized by Apple
  • Optional: download and install updates automatically

    • Install: [Nook.dmg](https://github.com/YusufLisawi/nook/releases/download/v1.2.0/Nook.dmg) · or `curl -fsSL https://nook.motkan.com/install.sh | bash`
